full_judgment:
2. The relevant facts necessary for the disposal of this Civil Appeal are that the appellant as plaintiff instituted Civil Suit No.238 of 2011 impleading the respondents as defendants for a declaration of title in the suit land and also for declaration of Power of Attorney executed by the defendant No.1 being null and void not binding upon the plaintiff also for cancellation of Settlement Case No.01/2005-06. The case of the plaintiff, inter alia, is that the plaintiffs mother Mostafa Khatun was the original owner of the suit land measuring 01 acre and she got the suit land in. the year 1971-72 pursuant to Settlement Case No. 23(D) of 1971-72 and took over possession of the suit land and paid rent there-of. The government declared the suit land along with its adjacent land as Khas land for establishment of Parjatan Corporation in the year 1982. After establishment of Parjatan Corporation 8.53 acres of land was found in excess which was vested in the Bazar Fund Administration and the same was kept out of the Parjatan Corporation area. Thereafter, a decision was taken for resettlement of the said excess land amongst the affected persons and accordingly 30 decimal of land instead of 1.00 acre was given settlement in the name of the plaintiffs mother Mostafa Khatun. The plaintiff and his mother went to the concerned office and filed their objection, but did not get any relief. Meanwhile all settlement process in respect of the land of Hill. Districts stopped in the year 1986. The plaintiffs mother Mostafa Khatun died on 01.06.1984 leaving the plaintiff and one daughter defendant No.2. After the death of the plaintiffs mother, the plaintiff and the defendant No2 had been residing in the suit land with their family members. The defendant No.1 is the son of the defendant No.2 and he created a false Power of Attorney in respect of the suit land to grab the same. The defendant No.1 filed Miscellaneous Case No.17 of 1984 before the Deputy Commissioner and thereafter filed Civil Suit No.72 of 2004 claiming that Mostafa Khatun is the grandmother of the defendant No.1 and the suit land is to be recorded in his name in the Bazar Fund Administration. On 10.01.2005 the Deputy Commissioner directed the concerned official to make settlement in favour of the defendant No.1 in respect of 1.00 acre of land on the priority basis if the settlement process starts again. Thereafter, the defendant No.1 filed Review Miscellaneous Case No.05 of 2008 before the Deputy Commissioner and subsequently upon transfer to the learned Joint District Judge the same was renumbered as Miscellaneous Case No.17 of 1984 which was allowed on 25.05.2009 with a direction to record the suit land in the name of the defendant No.1 under the Bazar Fund Tauzi and accordingly the suit land was recorded in the name of the defendant No.1 through Settlement Case No.01/ 2005-06. Mostafa Khatun died on 01.06.1984 and the defendant No.1 created the Power of Attorney beyond the knowledge of the plaintiff by practicing fraud upon the authority and also got recorded his name in respect of the snit land under the Bazar Fund Tauzi which is illegal and void. The defendant No.1 has concocted the said Power of Attorney to deprive the plaintiff and other heirs of Mostafa Khatun. Thus the title of the plaintiff had become clouded and hence the suit. 

 3. The defendant No.1respondent No.1 contested the suit filing written statement denying all the material averments made in the plaint and contended, inter alia, that the suit is not maintainable in its present form and is barred by limitation. The plaintiff has no right, title, interest and possession on the suit land and the plaintiff has no locus standi to file the suit. The suit land was settled in the name of Mostafa Khatun by Settlement Case No.23 (D) of 1971-72 and the same was declared as Khas land on 08.09.1976 by the Deputy Commissioner and vested to the Bazar Fund Administration. The plaintiffs mother executed and registered a bond being No.146/84-85 on 24.07.1984 in favour of the defendant No.l. The defendant No.1 is entitled to get all legal facilities over the movable or immovable properties of Mostafa Khatun by the registered Power of Attorney and accordingly the plaintiff on 05.08.1984 executed a Nadabi Patra in favour of the defendant No.1, thus the defendant No.1 is entitled to get 1.00 acre of land from the Bazar Fund Administration. Subsequently the defendant No.1 filed Civil Suit No.72 of 2004 and obtained an order to be recorded 1.00 acre of land thereby resumed the settlement process. Later on, he filed Review Misc. Case No.05 of 2008 which was renumbered as Miscellaneous Case No.236 of 2008 and obtained an order directing the Bazar Fund Administration to record his name. The defendant No.1 got the suit land by way of settlement from the Bazar Fund Administration and got his name recorded in the Bazar Fund Tauzi filing Settlement Case No.1/20052006 on 23.06.2009 and since then the defendant No.1 has been possessing the suit land paying rent thereof. The plaintiff did not raise any claim or objection in respect of the suit land even before the Bazar Fund Administration or the concerned Deputy Commissioner, Rangamati Hill District. The land of the plaintiffs predecessor was vested to the Government on 08.09.1976 and as such the plaintiff or his predecessor has no right, title or interest in the suit land. The suit is liable to be dismissed.
